scientific_scope: coverage/identifiability audit only; no D|T model fit, no tail-law fit, no predictive score claim

source.name: eatpizzanot/soccer-dataset
source.identity_gate: same C071 threshold-8 strict-PIT opportunity-history eligible identities

population: eligible completed pre-2024 matches with exact total T>=7
required_outputs: exact-total frequency for every observed T>=7
for each observed T: legal D support {-T,-T+2,...,+T}, observed D support, missing legal classes, class counts, minimum/median/maximum class count
for each observed T: unique leagues and calendar years
parity/integer score mapping audit for every row
aggregate support summaries for T=7, T=8, T=9, T>=10

interpretation_boundary.reason: sample-size sufficiency depends on the future model family and validation design; this audit reports raw support rather than manufacturing a promotion threshold
